projects.title: Web Development
projects.description: Built responsive websites and interactive web apps focusing on UX, accessibility, and performance.
projects.source: With a strong foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Prompting, I have developed a diverse range of static and dynamic websites, focusing on both functionality and user experience. My web development projects include business websites, personal portfolios, blogs, and interactive applications, each designed to be visually appealing and responsive.

projects.title: Decoding SuperDense Coding (Amravathi Quantum Valley Hackathon)
projects.description: Designed and implemented a quantum circuit simulator demonstrating the Superdense Coding protocol; integrated Qiskit AerSimulator and a Streamlit UI for real-time interaction.
projects.source: Designed the overall system architecture for a quantum computing simulator implementing the Superdense Coding Protocol. Planned and established a modular code structure, separating core quantum logic, configuration management, and user interface components for maintainability and scalability. Developed the technical framework enabling real-time quantum circuit simulation, multi-user authentication, and advanced security features. Collaborated with the development team to integrate Qiskit AerSimulator, Streamlit UI, and comprehensive testing.

projects.title: Parsing of Scan Documents Using AI-Based OCR Techniques (DLRL)
projects.description: Built an end-to-end OCR pipeline combining traditional OCR and deep-learning to extract structured data from scanned documents; deployed a prototype for DRDO with robust preprocessing and post-processing.
projects.source: Designed the complete system architecture and developed the end-to-end OCR pipeline for scanned documents. Implemented integrated workflows combining traditional OCR with AI-based methods for structured data extraction. Developed and tested the prototype, ensuring robustness, accuracy, and scalability. Led testing, optimization, and deployment of the solution, delivering it successfully to the concerned department at DRDO.
